game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle, a saddle between peaks: the mountaineer must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Palindrome Gate: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate.
theme: Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle: a saddle between peaks
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Saddle, repeat each round: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the gate value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the pass gate using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The pass gate reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the pass gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 6 (applied tier): Palindrome Gate
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Palindrome Gate' (Week 8 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Blizzard Saddle'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Blizzard Saddle.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The pass gate reached with actions_used <= 21.
